FAMILY FEEDBACK

How was this activity?

Your feedback helps us make Kiddo School better. This is feedback about the activity, for the grown-ups who make it — it is never about a child.

Comments stay short and are read by the school office before they appear. Don’t include private information — no surnames, ages or addresses.

    MY WORK · TRACE & FOLLOW

    Trace & Follow

    Trace the big line with your finger. Wobbly is wonderful.

    This one needs JavaScript. Open it in your browser to trace.

    Path 1 of 6

    Straight line

    Trace the line. Up and down.

    Across

    Trace the line. Side to side.

    Wavy line

    Trace the wiggly line.

    Zigzag

    Trace the zigzag.

    Big circle

    Trace the circle. Round and round.

    Simple curve

    Trace the curve.

    Nice tracing!

    That is all six paths. More tracing can wait — it will be here another day.
